description: This file defines extension methods for configuring streaming functionalities on Orleans silos and clients, including adding streaming support, persistent streams, and stream filters.

classes.name: SiloBuilderStreamingExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for configuring streaming on Orleans silos and clients.

methods.name: AddStreaming
methods.description: Adds support for streaming to the silo builder.

methods.name: AddPersistentStreams
methods.description: Configures the silo to use persistent streams with specified provider name, adapter factory, and configuration delegate.

methods.name: AddStreamFilter<T>
methods.description: Adds a stream filter of type T to the silo builder.

methods.name: AddStreamFilter<T>
methods.description: Adds a stream filter of type T to the client builder.
